name: Tokiwa Yuuji
source:
Better known as “MENTALIST YUJI.”
An influencer with a doctorate in neuroscience, he is primarily active through online video platforms.
He uses his specialist knowledge to speak with the polished air of a public intellectual, but his remarks frequently divide opinion. At this point, many people associate him first and foremost with online controversy.
He does not seem to realize it himself, but his habitually condescending tone has a way of creating friction with those around him.
He is close friends with fellow influencer Uchibori Keisuke, and the two frequently collaborate on each other's channels.

[From in-game tips]
